digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation; transition close workflow
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires the MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when _referencing_commit_exists actually scans the entire git history from current HEAD regardless of merge status.
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and the completion-verification gate being enabled, but the documentation presents it as unconditional.
AGENTS.md does not document rebar transition --ref, which allows closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but the documentation implies the precheck enforces it.
The referencing-commit check accepts any transitive descendant of the ticket (from list_descendants), not just the ticket itself, but this subtree scope is not documented.
